run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-16T21:46:54Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alerting service frontend-proxy did begin returning errors around the moment Chaos Mesh started a network fault, but the fault's specification is not readable in this Run, so the causal conclusion is partial. Observation: frontend-proxy's 5-minute ERROR span rate for span_name=ingress was 0.0074-0.0185 spans/s through the 21:47 sample and rose to 0.137/s (21:49), 0.379-0.485/s (21:51-21:59) and 0.358/s (22:01), while its STATUS_CODE_UNSET ingress span rate stayed ~9.3-10.5 spans/s. Every failing trace sampled follows one path: load-generator -> frontend-proxy ingress -> frontend POST /api/checkout -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder -> shipping /get-quote, whose client span 'POST quote' ends with otel.status_description 'Timeout' after ~5.0 s and no quote service span, so shipping returns 'Internal Server Error' and the checkout error text is '13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500'. At 21:46:48Z, before the alert's reported start, the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition (namespace chaos-mesh) spawned otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition-9xnx8, which reports 'Successfully apply chaos' for pods otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv and otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w, then TimeUp/Recovered ~55 s later; the cycle repeats at :48 each minute through 21:55:48Z. Quote's log stops its continuous 'Calculated quote' output at 21:46:46 and afterwards emits only in bursts at :43 of each minute, which is consistent with requests being blocked at the network level rather than quote failing internally. Email was checked and shows no own failure: POST /send_order_confirmation spans carry http.status_code 200, no email ERROR span series exists in the window, email pods have 0 restarts, and email call volume simply fell with the falling successful-checkout rate; the 'got 500' wording about an email POST therefore could not be corroborated and is recorded as an unresolved discrepancy. No pod restarts/OOM/evictions were observed, all 21 otel-demo deployments are 1/1 ready, endpoints point at the running pods, and every flagd fault-injection flag reads 'off'.

claims.text: frontend-proxy's own trace error signal deviated: the 5-minute rate of ERROR spans for span_name=ingress was 0 through the 21:25 sample, stayed at 0.0074-0.0185 spans/s through the 21:47 sample, then rose to 0.137/s (21:49), 0.379/s (21:51), 0.485/s (21:53), 0.470/s (21:55), 0.456/s (21:57 and 21:59) and 0.358/s (22:01), while STATUS_CODE_UNSET ingress span rate stayed ~9.3-10.5 spans/s.

Over 21:46:19-22:04:19 the ERROR span increase by service was frontend 1580.4, frontend-proxy 800.7, shipping 770.1, checkout 765.4, ad 2.1, fraud-detection 1.05, recommendation 1.05, accounting 0 and payment 0; no ERROR series was returned for email, quote, cart, currency or product-catalog.
For frontend-proxy over the same 18 minutes, span counts (not request counts) were SPAN_KIND_CLIENT 397.19 ERROR vs 8556.91 UNSET and SPAN_KIND_SERVER 403.48 ERROR vs 8549.57 UNSET.

Trace 57075df3f14f46a92d8ea1cf5a6dbdd0 shows the failing path: load-generator POST (http.status_code 500) -> frontend-proxy ingress 500 -> router frontend egress 500 -> frontend POST /api/checkout 500 -> frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder rpc.grpc.status_code 13 -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 13 -> prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart -> checkout 'HTTP POST' error -> shipping /get-quote error with otel.status_description 'Internal Server Error' (5.001212 s) -> shipping 'POST quote' error with otel.status_description 'Timeout' (5.001029 s); no quote service span appears in that trace.

The error text recorded on frontend and checkout spans in this incident window is exactly '13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500' (also as otel.status_description 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500' on checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans).

Chaos Mesh events show Schedule otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition (namespace chaos-mesh) spawned NetworkChaos otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition-9xnx8 at 2026-11-16T21:46:48Z with 'Experiment has started', 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv' and 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w', then 'Time up according to the duration' and 'Recovered' for both pods at 21:47:43Z; further objects (…-nz4lm, …-85v74, …-rw58g, …-lwvxl, …-769cj, …-q7g8w, …-fsflv, …-5ks6l, …-5czjs) repeat the start-at-:48 / recover-at-:43 cycle through 21:55:48Z, each naming the same two pods.

Event grouping for the authorized window returned 20 NetworkChaos 'Applied', 10 'Started', 9 'TimeUp', 18 'Recovered', 95 'Updated' and 19 'FinalizerInited' events in namespace chaos-mesh, 10 Schedule 'Spawned' and related Schedule events in chaos-mesh, and 38 PodNetworkChaos 'Updated' events in namespace otel-demo; the only otel-demo-namespace entries in that grouping were these PodNetworkChaos updates.

Quote pod quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w (container quote, no previous instance) logged 'Calculated quote' continuously until 21:46:46.394357Z, then nothing until 21:47:43.083652Z, and afterwards its log lines cluster at :43 of each minute (21:47:43 through 21:56:43).

Shipping pod shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv logged 'Requesting quote' repeatedly (e.g. 21:55:19.8 through 21:55:41.2) with 'Sending Quote' replies only in bursts just after the chaos recovery instants (21:55:43.2-21:55:44.1 and 21:56:43.2-21:56:43.9).

email POST /send_order_confirmation spans fell from 38.7-65.3 per 2 minutes through 21:47 to 8.0-10.7 per 2 minutes afterwards, and quote POST /getquote fell in the same way, with all of those series at STATUS_CODE_UNSET only (no ERROR series for either service).

Email service spans observed in the window are successful server spans: POST /send_order_confirmation carries http.status_code 200 (e.g. span d8fa0500041fcd4a at 21:56:43), and a full successful checkout trace at 21:56:41 shows shipping /get-quote and the checkout email POST both returning 200.

All otel-demo pods listed are Running with restartCount 0, including email-59f69bc6cf-8z5c5, quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w, shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv, checkout-5dccddf8bb-pd7qk, frontend-675fd7b5c5-kgxrg and frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-wvxht.
All 21 otel-demo deployments report 1 ready / 1 available / 1 updated replica, including checkout, email, quote, shipping and frontend-proxy.

Endpoints for services email, quote, shipping and checkout each expose one ready address pointing at the current pod (email 100.96.2.193 -> email-59f69bc6cf-8z5c5, quote 100.96.1.165 -> quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w, shipping 100.96.1.109 -> shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv, checkout 100.96.3.186 -> checkout-5dccddf8bb-pd7qk) on port 8080.
Deployment env shows shipping's QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080, checkout's EMAIL_ADDR=http://email:8080, and the quote container has no email-related env var (only QUOTE_PORT and OTel settings).

As read, ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config has every fault-injection flag at defaultVariant 'off' (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure).

frontend-proxy logged 503 responses with 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' against frontend both before and during the alert window: 21:40:39, 21:40:56, 21:41:06, 21:43:08, 21:43:37, 21:45:54, 21:47:54, 21:53:25 (two), 21:54:27 and 21:56:18.

Primary hypothesis: the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition (namespace chaos-mesh) is the root cause — each minute from 21:46:48Z it created a NetworkChaos experiment applied to pods shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv and quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w for ~55 s, cutting shipping's HTTP POST to quote:8080, producing the ~5 s 'Timeout' on shipping's 'POST quote' span, the shipping /get-quote 500, the checkout PlaceOrder INTERNAL error, the frontend POST /api/checkout 500s seen in frontend-proxy ingress spans and therefore the RequestErrorRate alert. Caveat: this attribution rests on Kubernetes events plus trace/log correlation; the NetworkChaos and Schedule specs (action, direction, selectors, duration) could not be read.

Unresolved second hypothesis: because the recorded error text asserts a failed 'POST to email service' answered 500, an email-side or checkout->email network fault may also have been part of the injected partition (the chaos object's name contains 'email-checkout'); email's own telemetry does not corroborate it, so it remains open rather than established.

Third open question about the same fault: whether the block was applied to the quote pod's inbound path, the shipping pod's egress path, or bidirectionally cannot be determined, because only the applied pod names and the TimeUp/Recovered timings are visible, not the NetworkChaos direction or selectors.

Rejected: a flagd feature-flag fault (for example emailMemoryLeak or paymentFailure) driving these 500s. The flagd-config ConfigMap read during this investigation has every flag at defaultVariant 'off', and the failing path is a timeout between shipping and quote, not an application-level failure flag.

Rejected: pod crash, OOM, eviction or deployment unavailability of shipping, quote, email, checkout or frontend-proxy. All these pods are Running with 0 restarts, all otel-demo deployments report 1/1 ready, their endpoints are populated, and the returned event set contains no Evicted, OOMKilled, BackOff or Unhealthy event for an otel-demo pod.

Rejected: the frontend-proxy 503 'upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' responses on GET routes explain the alert deviation. They occur at a similar cadence before the alert (21:40:39-21:45:54) and during it (21:47:54-21:56:18), so they are background rather than the change that moved the alerting signal.

Against an email-service root cause: email's own telemetry shows no failure — POST /send_order_confirmation spans record http.status_code 200, no email ERROR span series appears in the window, and its call-volume drop (38.7-65.3 per 2 min to 8.0-10.7) parallels quote's, consistent with fewer successful checkouts reaching it.

Against quote being internally broken: the quote pod is Running with 0 restarts, all quote span series returned are STATUS_CODE_UNSET with no ERROR series, and quote's log shows its request handling stopping at 21:46:46 and resuming only in bursts at the chaos recovery instants (21:47:43 onward), i.e. requests stopped arriving rather than failing inside the service.

Advisory: read the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition and its generated NetworkChaos objects (chaos-mesh namespace) to confirm action/direction/selectors/duration, and pause that Schedule; then re-check shipping's 'POST quote' latency, quote's 21:46-22:00 request intake and the frontend-proxy /api/checkout error rate for recovery.

Advisory: reconcile the checkout/shipping error string 'failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500' with the observed shipping->quote timeout (quote unreachable within ~5 s, email answering 200), since the message misdirects diagnosis to the email service.

gaps: The alerting rule RequestErrorRate could not be retrieved: list_prometheus_rules returned status no_data both for rule_name=RequestErrorRate and for type=alert, so the rule's expression, window and the reported current value 0.6444444444444444 could not be verified against the rule definition.

The Chaos Mesh resources themselves could not be read: chaos-mesh NetworkChaos, PodNetworkChaos and Schedule objects are not among the readable Kubernetes kinds, so their spec (action, direction, selectors/labels, duration, whether they target email or quote/shipping) is unknown; the fault is documented only by events, which is why the cause is a hypothesis and the conclusion partial.
A filtered quote-log query for the patterns error|fail|exception|warn returned status no_data, so the absence of error lines in the quote container is unknown, not established.
The email container log read returned status no_data with zero lines in 21:40-22:04 (and no previous container instance exists), so email's own stdout/stderr during the incident is unknown.

The claim in the error text that a POST to the email service received 500 could not be corroborated: email spans seen were 200 with no ERROR status, no email error trace matched (traces_search_by_tags error=true returned no_data for service email), and an untagged or unexported email 5xx cannot be excluded.
The networkpolicy listing returned status no_data (no objects and no labels returned), so whether a static NetworkPolicy contributed could not be determined.

Kubernetes objects and events reflect only state/timestamps available at query time (collected events start at 21:29:56Z), so chaos episodes before 21:46:48Z and the Schedule's behavior after 21:56:16Z are unknown.
Small ERROR-span counts for ad (2.09), fraud-detection (1.05) and recommendation (1.05) over 18 minutes were not investigated per service and are not tied to this alert.

Two metrics probes returned no_data rather than values — get_series for {__name__="http_server_request_duration_seconds_count",service_name="frontend-proxy"} and get_metric_names for http_*|rpc_* — so any HTTP-level error metric outside the traces_span_metrics_* family is unknown, not zero.
next_steps: Inspect and pause/disable the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition in namespace chaos-mesh and review its generated NetworkChaos specs to confirm what was partitioned and for how long.

Retrieve the RequestErrorRate alert rule definition from the Prometheus/Alertmanager configuration to confirm its expression, window and threshold, and reconcile the reported 0.6444 value with the observed frontend-proxy error-span rate.
Re-check shipping 'POST quote' latency, quote request intake and the frontend-proxy /api/checkout 5xx rate after the Schedule stops to confirm recovery.
Fix or clarify the shipping/checkout error mapping so a shipping->quote timeout is not reported as a failed POST to the email service.
